_comment_tools: opencode scopes agents with a permission map (allow/ask/deny; the boolean `tools` map is deprecated), so tools_style permission-map renders '*': deny plus explicit allows. tool_map values are opencode permission keys; `list` rides the search capability because glob-style discovery is what that capability means on this runner.
_comment_models: Runner-specific spellings of the registry bindings (registry/models.yaml is the authority for WHICH model each role gets), in opencode's provider/model-id form from its Models.dev catalog. Any-provider harness: model_overrides implement the P5 vendor pins (reviewer/verifier decorrelated from the Claude-backed implementer), mirroring the copilot-cli choices. IDs are ILLUSTRATIVE like the registry's — pin to your org's models and verify the spelling with `opencode models <provider>`.
_comment_model_vendors: Vendor of each runner spelling above, for the orchestrator's dispatch-time P5 check (avoid_vendor_of).
_comment_mode: mode: all lets a rendered agent be dispatched directly (`opencode run --agent <role>`) and invoked as a subagent; the rendered permission map is the ceiling either way.
_comment_headless: v1 orchestrator dispatch (docs/ORCHESTRATOR.md §5). --agent selects the rendered agent, whose frontmatter (incl. model_overrides above) pins the model. --auto is what makes runs unattended: it auto-approves ask-level permission prompts and honors deny, and the rendered maps only contain allow/deny, so nothing is silently widened. usage_report format static-estimate: `opencode run --format json` emits an event stream whose usage fields are not yet verified live; until they are, metering falls back to the registry's dispatch_estimates_usd entry, recorded in the ledger with tokens null (same posture as copilot-cli).
